# Pokémon Explorer

> A fast, modern Pokédex web app built on the public PokéAPI. Browse, search,
> filter, and sort every Pokémon, view detailed stats and moves, and compare
> any two Pokémon side by side.

Pokémon Explorer is a client-rendered Next.js app. Every Pokémon's data
(stats, types, abilities, moves, sprites) is fetched live from PokéAPI at
https://pokeapi.co — this site does not host or modify that data.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pokemon-pipeline.vercel.app/): search, type filter, and sort
  the full Pokédex.
- [Pokémon detail](https://pokemon-pipeline.vercel.app/pikachu): replace the
  last path segment with any Pokémon's name (e.g. `/charizard`, `/mewtwo`)
  for its stats, abilities, and moves.
- [Compare](https://pokemon-pipeline.vercel.app/compare): side-by-side stat
  comparison for any two Pokémon.

## Notes for agents

- Pokémon names in URLs are lowercase, PokéAPI's own slug format (e.g.
  `mr-mime`, `nidoran-f`).
- There is no authentication and no write access — every route is read-only.
